prompt:
You are an autonomous agent operating inside the current working directory. BEFORE anything else, write out a numbered plan that covers every step listed below (no fewer than 8 steps). Use the planning/todo tool you have; if you have none, put the plan into plan.md. Then carry out the steps in order, writing every required file under the exact filename stated. Never invent content: every statement must be traceable to the fixture files shipped in this directory. Once every artifact exists and has been checked, wrap up with a brief completion summary.

The two-file project in this directory (inventory.py, test_inventory.py) fails its tests. test_inventory.py is the immutable specification.

Work order (plan at least 8 steps):
1. Produce your plan.
2. Copy inventory.py and test_inventory.py into the working directory if they are not already here; run python -m pytest test_inventory.py -q and paste the failing output into failure_analysis.md.
3. In failure_analysis.md give one section per bug: failing test, root cause in the source, planned repair. Four distinct bugs are planted.
4. BEFORE changing inventory.py, write repro_tests.py: small direct pytest cases (one per bug) that each demonstrate the faulty behaviour. Run it and attach the output to failure_analysis.md.
5. Repair inventory.py. Public signatures must not change; test_inventory.py must not be edited.
6. Re-run both suites until everything is green.
7. Write regression_notes.md: per bug one line describing the actual code change, plus the tail of the final pytest run.
8. Verify python -m py_compile inventory.py and finish.
plan_steps: Run the failing suite and capture the baseline
Write repro_tests.py reproducing every symptom BEFORE fixing
Record the diff rationale in regression_notes.md
